releases.title: PL-300 Full Ranked Learning 509/509
releases.summary: Makes all 509 PL-300 source question occurrences part of one ranked learning journey while preserving fair competitive scoring across 265 validated concepts.
highlights: Full Ranked Bank now exposes all 509 source occurrences as the primary PL-300 study journey: 369 from Source 01 and 140 from Source 02.
Ranking is completion-first: every source occurrence must be studied before a learner can lead on full-bank completion.
Validated Accuracy and Mastery are concept-weighted across 265 evidence-backed concepts; duplicate source copies collapse to one competitive concept weight.
Source blocks that cannot be scored safely become required Study Checkpoints. They count toward 509/509 completion but never award self-declared correctness.
The shared Full Ranked Learning leaderboard orders Completion, Validated Mastery, First Pass, Attempts-to-Best, then Active Solve Time.
Existing 265-question Domain Ranked Learning remains intact for deterministic exam-style scoring; Full Ranked Learning adds source-complete study coverage without changing protected exam banks.

releases.title: Production Release Candidate
releases.summary: Freezes the 265-question PL-300 Native Ranked Engine for production deployment after final responsive/dark-theme, ranking-sync, cache/update, performance, package-integrity, and localhost acceptance gates.
highlights: PL-300 Ranked Learning remains locked at 265 reviewed questions: 201 canonical text questions plus 64 reviewed Native Structured questions.
All 509 source question blocks remain available through Full Source Practice; 14 Native Structured candidates remain intentionally fail-closed from Ranking.
Production release identity, cache-busting, What's New fallback, and changelog metadata are unified on V0.22.0.
Responsive and dark-theme regression gates remain mandatory, including keyboard focus, warning contrast, early theme bootstrapping, and startup performance budgets.
Shared Ranking/Supabase integration remains isolated to anonymous attempt/profile metadata with local-first fallback behavior.
The production package excludes temporary planning workspaces and is required to pass fresh extracted-package QA and localhost HTTP smoke before deployment.

releases.title: PL-300 Native Ranked Engine
releases.summary: Promotes 64 explicitly reviewed source-backed Native Structured PL-300 questions into Domain Ranked Learning, expanding the ranked bank from 201 to 265 while keeping 14 native candidates fail-closed.
highlights: The PL-300 Ranked Bank now contains 265 questions: 201 reviewed canonical text questions and 64 reviewed Native Structured questions.
Native Ranked responses support fields and ordered-fields with normalized-text scoring, explicit confirmation in Instant Feedback, and editable responses in Feedback at End.
Structured questions integrate with Resume, Navigator filters/status, first-pass accuracy, active-solve timing, results, My Mistakes, Domain Ranking, Overall Ranking, and section/topic analytics.
Domain coverage is 75 Prepare the Data, 63 Model the Data, 67 Visualize & Analyze the Data, and 60 Manage & Secure Power BI.

All 78 Native Structured source candidates have explicit review decisions: 64 approved and 14 withheld for duplicate, conflict, ambiguity, unstable UI wording, insufficient evidence, or free-form scoring.
Full Source Practice continues to preserve all 509 source blocks and source-review records themselves remain non-ranked; no synthetic distractors were introduced.

releases.title: PL-300 Ranked Conflict Closure
releases.summary: Resolves the final unlinked rankable PL-300 text conflict with owner-approved C-017, expands the reviewed Ranked Bank to 201 questions, and fail-closes the malformed tooltip variants to non-ranked source-reveal practice.
highlights: C-017 approves Enable high-density sampling for the 10-million-row scatter-plot scenario while preserving the conflicting Source 02 trend-line key as provenance.
The reviewed PL-300 Ranked Bank expands from 200 to 201 questions; Real Exam remains 60 questions / 120 minutes and Domain Ranked Learning behavior is unchanged.
The two malformed tooltip variants remain traceable in Full Source Practice but are converted to source-reveal/self-grade and excluded from Ranking.
All 509 source blocks remain practiceable: 321 text auto-scored, 78 Native Structured auto-scored, and 110 source-reveal/self-graded.
The canonical text bank is now 271 questions: 201 production-ready plus 70 intentionally fail-closed questions.
Native Structured visual responses remain non-ranked until a dedicated ranked free-text/ordered-field response engine is implemented; no synthetic distractors were created.

releases.title: PL-300 Native Source Practice + Conflict Audit
releases.summary: Upgrades source-faithful PL-300 practice with native scoring for 78 visual/answer-area items and adds deterministic duplicate/answer-conflict auditing while keeping the 200-question ranked bank fail-closed.
highlights: All 509 source blocks remain practiceable: 323 text items auto-score, 78 visual/answer-area items use source-evidence-only Native Structured scoring, and 108 remain source reveal + self-grade.
Native Structured Practice stores per-field answers locally, grades normalized text without inventing distractors, and remains explicitly non-ranked.
A full-source dedup audit records 34 normalized duplicate clusters and 9 answer-conflict candidates; normalized-text fingerprints are audit evidence, not a semantic-unique count.
The only four unlinked text-scoreable blocks form two near-duplicate source-key conflict clusters, so the ranked production bank remains 200 pending explicit owner approval.
No Official QBank, course Question Bank, course Exam, PL-300 master-bank, or draft-master-bank assessment payload is intentionally changed in this release.

releases.title: PL-300 Full Source Practice: 509/509 Practiceable
releases.summary: Turns every actual question block from both uploaded PL-300 PDFs into persistent non-ranked practice while preserving the reviewed 200-question ranked bank.
highlights: All 509 actual source question blocks are practiceable: 323 text questions auto-score from preserved source keys and 186 visual/answer-area items use source-faithful self-grading after reveal.
Single-select and multi-select text items now support real answer selection, Check answer, correct/wrong styling, retry, and persistent local progress.
Hotspot, Drag & Drop, Fill-in-the-Blank and other visual-heavy source questions keep their original question/answer evidence and add I got it right / I missed it self-grading.
Source Practice state is stored inside digilians.voucher and is preserved by Progress Backup/Restore merges.
The reviewed 200-question Domain Ranked Learning bank, Domain/Overall ranking logic, answer keys, and protected assessment payloads are unchanged.

releases.title: PL-300 Full Source Ingestion: Both Uploaded PDFs
releases.summary: Ingests every actual question block from both uploaded PL-300 PDFs into a source-faithful non-ranked review layer while keeping the 200-question reviewed ranked bank unchanged.
highlights: Full Source Review now contains 509 actual source question blocks: 369 from PL-300 Final.pdf and 140 from PL-300 Final 2.pdf.
The trailing Source 02 NEW QUESTION 415 marker is explicitly excluded because it is promotional product copy, not an exam question.
323 text-scoreable items preserve source options and answer tokens; 186 visual or answer-area items use source reveal instead of invented scoring.
552 derived WebP source-review assets preserve question and answer evidence for Hotspot, Drag & Drop, Fill-in-the-Blank, and other visual-heavy source items.
The existing 200-question reviewed production bank, Domain Ranked Learning, Overall Ranking, My Mistakes, Section Analytics, and protected assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: PL-300 Integration Polish: My Mistakes, Section Analytics & Visual Audit
releases.summary: Finishes the pre-release PL-300 integration layer with Domain/Section-aware My Mistakes, ranked Section Analytics, a fail-closed visual production audit, and the owner-approved Q184 scoring correction.
highlights: My Mistakes now keeps PL-300 Voucher provenance down to Domain and Section, including safe backfill for existing stored mistakes.
Each ranked PL-300 Domain now exposes Section Analytics in canonical section order, including strongest/weakest section signals from the best official attempt.
The PL-300 visual audit now validates released exhibit coverage, asset existence, alt text, manifest provenance and completed manual review before pre-deploy can pass.
All 45 released visual-backed PL-300 questions completed manual review; no released exhibit-dependent question is missing a visual asset.
Owner-approved correction C-016 scores Source 01 Q184 as role-playing dimension while preserving the original Type 2 SCD source answer as provenance.

releases.title: PL-300 Full Ranked QA: Navigator Status, Filters & Overall Ranking
releases.summary: Completes the PL-300 Domain Ranked Learning QA pass by fixing grouped navigator answer states and filters, and by wiring the promised Overall PL-300 leaderboard from all four official Domain results.
highlights: Instant Feedback now colors grouped Domain navigator questions green for correct and red for wrong after confirmation; Mark for Review remains an independent star overlay.
The Answered filter now actually shows only answered questions; All, Unanswered, Answered and Marked share the same stable Domain/Section model.
PL-300 Overall Ranking is now a real shared leaderboard built from each learner’s best official attempt in all four Domains.
Overall ranking orders Total Mastery, First-Pass Accuracy, Attempts-to-Best, then total Active Solve Time; learners missing any Domain remain outside the official Overall board.
Voucher context breadcrumbs from V0.21.5 are preserved, and the accepted 200-question PL-300 bank plus all protected assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: Voucher Exam Context Hotfix: PL-300 Domain Breadcrumbs
releases.summary: Keeps PL-300 Domain attempts anchored to Voucher context even when the saved progress intentionally omits the full generated exam payload.
highlights: PL-300 ranked Domain attempts now resolve context from the compact Voucher resume metadata instead of falling back to stale English / Module setup breadcrumbs.
YOU ARE SOLVING now follows Voucher → Microsoft PL-300 → current Domain for Domain-ranked attempts.
THIS QUESTION now shows the current Domain → exact learning section, such as Prepare the Data → Data Sources & Connectivity.
The navigator heading now identifies Microsoft PL-300 and the active Domain while preserving the grouped Section Navigator and stable question numbers.
Official QBank, My Mistakes, generic course exams, ranking rules, answer keys, timers and the accepted 200-question PL-300 bank are unchanged.

releases.title: PL-300 Domain Ranked Learning: Domain Attempts + Section Navigator
releases.summary: Rebuilds PL-300 around four complete ranked Domain attempts while keeping the ten curriculum sessions as visible learning sections inside the exam navigator.
highlights: The four PL-300 Domains are now the official ranked activities; sessions are learning sections for navigation, breakdowns and review rather than separate leaderboards.
Each Domain supports Instant Feedback or Feedback at End, with both modes contributing to the same Domain Ranking and no countdown pressure.
A grouped Section Navigator on the left shows the current section, answered progress, marked questions and stable question numbers; mobile uses a drawer trigger.
Domain ranking orders best completed attempts by mastery, first-pass accuracy, attempts-to-best and active solve time; incomplete attempts remain provisional and local.
Domain attempts bypass legacy Voucher size validation, removing the Choose a valid Voucher mock size error from structured PL-300 learning.
Legacy Session, 60Q and Full Bank attempts remain readable in history but are no longer primary PL-300 ranking paths.
The accepted 200-question PL-300 master bank and four-domain/ten-section content architecture remain unchanged.

releases.title: PL-300 Ranked Learning Core: Session Ranking + Instant Feedback
releases.summary: Rebuilds the primary PL-300 competition flow around the ten revision sessions so learners can study with instant feedback and still earn a fair session rank.
highlights: The ten PL-300 sessions become the primary ranked activities; legacy 60Q and Full Bank attempts remain readable but their cards are removed from the main Ranked Learning path.
Every ranked session supports Instant Feedback or Feedback at End, with both modes feeding the same session leaderboard.
Active Solve Time replaces countdown pressure for session ranking and pauses while instant feedback is being read or the attempt is safely exited.
Official session ranking requires a complete session attempt and sorts by final mastery, first-pass accuracy, attempts-to-best, then active solve time.
Incomplete session attempts stay provisional and local; result actions focus on Retake Session, Session Ranking, and My Mistakes while Quick Practice stays secondary and non-ranked.
A permanent Release Identity Gate now blocks version mismatches across VERSION.txt, HTML runtime identity, cache busting, update fallback, and changelog metadata.
The accepted 200-question PL-300 master bank and V0.21.2 four-domain/ten-session content architecture remain unchanged.

releases.title: PL-300 Content Architecture: 4 Domains / 10 Sessions
releases.summary: Maps all 200 reviewed PL-300 production questions into the approved four-domain, ten-session revision architecture and adds focused session practice while preserving all existing ranked-exam contracts.
highlights: All 200 reviewed PL-300 production questions map exactly once into four domains and ten focused revision sessions.
The PL-300 landing flow now presents the domain/session revision map before the existing global Ranked Challenge, Full Bank Ranked Exam, Improvement and Custom Practice paths.
Each session supports focused non-ranked Instant Feedback study and Exam-Style practice using only the session allowlist, with existing safe option shuffling and Exam Engine behavior.
Saved session attempts reconstruct the exact question and option order and restore the session title without changing the existing progress schema or localStorage keys.
The 60-question Ranked Challenge remains 120 minutes and unchanged; the 200-question Full Bank Ranked Exam remains 400 minutes with its separate leaderboard.
The V0.21.1 PL-300 master-bank question objects and answer keys remain unchanged; permanent Quick, Pre-Deploy and Windows package guards now require the content architecture registry/runtime.

releases.title: PL-300 Final Bank Review: 200Q Production Bank
releases.summary: Completes final triage of all 270 canonical PL-300 text questions, promotes 20 additional high-confidence items to a 200-question production bank, and keeps 70 explicitly reviewed items fail-closed.
highlights: PL-300 production bank expands from 180 to 200 reviewed questions; all 180 previously released master-bank question objects remain unchanged.
The 20 new questions have reviewed Arabic concept explanations, option-level rationales, current-scope verification metadata, and unchanged source answer keys.

All 70 non-production questions now carry explicit final review dispositions covering conflict, duplicate/variant, context, legacy, malformed source, visual completeness, scope confidence, or ambiguity.
Eleven answer-key/source-current-behavior conflicts remain withheld for owner approval; no unresolved conflict is silently rescored.
Full Bank Ranked Exam now covers all 200 reviewed questions in 400 minutes with its separate leaderboard; the 60-question Ranked Challenge remains 120 minutes and unchanged.
The accepted V0.21.0 modular Exam/Voucher/Ranking architecture and all non-PL-300 assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: Platform Architecture Refactor: Modular Core Baseline
releases.summary: Completes the incremental behavior-preserving architecture refactor and establishes stable modular boundaries for future Voucher, exam, ranking and track production work.
highlights: Exam runtime is split into focused Session, Timer, Answers, Navigation, Persistence, Feedback, Results and Mode modules exposed through one app-facing exam-engine.js facade.

Voucher core contracts are exposed through voucher-engine.js and Ranking Center scope construction is centralized in ranking-scopes.js without changing ranking IDs, score ordering or Supabase contracts.
Light/Dark semantic design tokens live in assets/css/tokens.css, and Ranking plus Avatar persistence now use explicit storage boundaries while preserving existing localStorage keys.

tools/architecture-check.mjs is now a permanent Full Pre-Deploy gate that blocks circular JS imports, core-facade violations, orchestrator storage leaks and unresolved CSS variables without fallbacks.
The final architecture audit reports zero JS import cycles, clean core facade boundaries, clean orchestrator storage boundaries and resolved CSS token usage.
PL-300 reviewed questions, answer keys, Official QBank, course Question Banks, Exams, timer rules, Resume schema, My Mistakes and protected assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: Voucher & Ranking Refactor: Core Boundaries
releases.summary: Reduces app.js coupling by introducing one Voucher core facade and a pure Ranking Center scope module while preserving all existing assessment and competition behavior.
highlights: assets/js/voucher-engine.js now exposes the existing Voucher registry, bank, storage, ranking, ranked-runtime and learning contracts through one app-facing facade.
app.js no longer imports voucher-registry.js, voucher-bank-engine.js, voucher-storage.js, voucher-ranking.js, voucher-ranked-runtime.js or voucher-learning.js directly.
assets/js/ranking-scopes.js now owns the six supported Ranking Center modes and pure Junior/Professional/Track aggregate scope construction.
Voucher Exam Ranking, Voucher Track Overall, Official aggregate ranking, Individual Exam Ranking, ranking activity IDs and Supabase contracts are unchanged.
Quick Local Check, Full Pre-Deploy and Windows Basic Check now require voucher-engine.js and ranking-scopes.js and focused refactor regressions protect their contracts.
PL-300 reviewed questions, answer keys, Official QBank, course Question Banks, Exams and protected assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: Exam Modes Refactor: Explicit Mode Profiles
releases.summary: Centralizes course, Official QBank, My Mistakes and Voucher exam-mode decisions behind explicit pure mode profiles while preserving all learner-visible assessment behavior.
highlights: assets/js/exam-modes.js now defines explicit profiles for Course Practice/Exam, Official Practice/Exam, My Mistakes, Voucher Practice, Ranked Learning, Full Bank Ranked and Improvement modes.
app.js resolves one active examMode at exam start and uses it for feedback normalization, ranked identity state, analytics lifecycle events and Voucher result-mode labeling.
Ranked Challenge remains instant-feedback solve-time competition; Full Bank Ranked remains end-feedback continuous-ranked; Improvement and Custom Practice remain non-ranked.
Official QBank ranking remains independent from whether the learner selects Instant Feedback or Exam Mode, preserving existing leaderboard behavior.
Quick Local Check, Full Pre-Deploy and Windows Basic Check now require exam-modes.js and the regression suite protects the mode-profile contract.
PL-300 reviewed questions, answer keys, Official QBank, course Question Banks, Exams and protected assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: Exam Engine Refactor Phase 2E: Integration Facade
releases.summary: Completes the Phase 2 Exam Engine integration boundary by routing app.js through one facade while preserving all existing exam behavior and extracted core contracts.
highlights: assets/js/exam-engine.js is now the single application-facing contract for Session, Timer, Answers, Navigation, Persistence, Feedback and Results core logic.
Fresh and restored attempts now use one createExamSession(...) entry point while preserving existing timer, Resume and state-normalization behavior.
app.js no longer imports the seven extracted Exam Engine core modules directly; DOM rendering and side effects remain in the controller for a behavior-preserving cleanup.
Quick Local Check, Full Pre-Deploy and Windows Basic Check now require exam-engine.js and run an integration regression that prevents direct-core imports from returning.
Ranked Challenge, Full Bank Ranked Exam, Practice, My Mistakes, Official QBank, score calculation, ranking payloads and LocalStorage schemas are unchanged.
PL-300 reviewed questions, answer keys, Official QBank, course Question Banks, Exams and protected assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: Exam Engine Refactor Phase 2D: Feedback & Results Core
releases.summary: Extracts feedback-state decisions and core result-record construction from app.js into focused pure modules while preserving feedback timing, scoring, ranking payloads and result UI behavior.
highlights: Instant-feedback readiness, ranked confirmation gating, multi-select detection and Voucher selection-status messaging now live in assets/js/exam-feedback.js.
Subject breakdowns, standard persisted result records, online ranking attempt payloads and result headline thresholds now live in assets/js/exam-results.js.
app.js remains responsible for DOM rendering, explanation markup, mistake recording, storage, analytics and online synchronization, keeping this slice narrowly behavior-preserving.
Ranked Challenge single-choice auto-submit, multi-select Confirm Answer, feedback-paused solve timer, Full Bank Exam Mode and separate ranking scopes are unchanged.
LocalStorage keys, Resume schema, timer policies, score calculation inputs, My Mistakes and protected assessment payloads are unchanged.
Quick Local Check, Full Pre-Deploy and Windows Basic Check now require exam-feedback.js and exam-results.js and run focused Phase 2D regressions.

releases.title: Exam Engine Refactor Phase 2C: Persistence Core
releases.summary: Extracts saved-attempt snapshot construction and persistence-related resume helpers from app.js into a focused pure module while preserving the progress schema, storage keys and Resume behavior.
highlights: The existing progressVersion 2 Save / Exit / Resume payload is now built by assets/js/exam-persistence.js and still written through storage.js.
Voucher resumes continue to persist compact deterministic reconstruction metadata: track/exam identity, runtime mode, question order and option order, without embedding the full Voucher bank.
Active-learner saved-progress filtering, continuous-ranked saved-remaining calculations, and exact Voucher saved-path matching now live behind the persistence boundary.
app.js still owns exam reconstruction and Resume orchestration in this slice, keeping Phase 2C behavior-preserving and narrowly scoped.
LocalStorage keys, saved-progress schema, timer policies, answer flow, navigation, feedback, scoring, ranking, My Mistakes and assessment content are unchanged.
Quick Local Check, Full Pre-Deploy and Windows Basic Check now require exam-persistence.js and run focused Phase 2C regressions.

releases.title: Exam Engine Refactor Phase 2B: Answers & Navigation Core
releases.summary: Extracts answer-state transitions and question-navigation state from app.js into focused pure runtime modules while preserving exam UI, scoring, feedback, timer and persistence behavior.
highlights: Single-choice selection, ranked-learning auto-confirm, multi-select toggling and confirmation state now live in assets/js/exam-answers.js while app.js remains responsible for UI rendering, persistence and timer side effects.
Navigator filter normalization, MARK toggling, direct question index clamping and Previous/Next movement now live in assets/js/exam-navigation.js.
The existing Ranked Challenge rule remains unchanged: single-choice submits immediately while multi-select requires Confirm Answer before feedback.
Saved attempt schema, LocalStorage keys, Resume behavior, score calculation, My Mistakes, ranking scopes and timer policies are unchanged.
Quick Local Check, Full Pre-Deploy and Windows Basic Check now require exam-answers.js and exam-navigation.js and run focused Phase 2B regressions.
PL-300 reviewed questions, answer keys, Official QBank, course Question Banks, Exams, curriculum and protected assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: Exam Engine Refactor Phase 2A: Session & Timer Core
releases.summary: Extracts exam session initialization and timer-policy/restore calculations from app.js into focused pure runtime modules without changing exam behavior.
highlights: Fresh and restored exam attempt state normalization now lives in assets/js/exam-session.js with current-index clamping, MARK deduplication, confirmed-answer state, feedback mode, timer state, and started-at restoration preserved.
Timer policy inference, learner-facing policy labels, and saved-attempt away-time calculations now live in assets/js/exam-timer.js.
Ranked Learning solve-time semantics still use voucher-ranked-runtime.js, preserving pause-during-feedback and count-away-time-while-solving behavior.
app.js remains the UI/controller layer; answer handlers, navigator rendering, persistence payload shape, feedback rendering, result calculation, ranking and My Mistakes are intentionally unchanged.
Quick Local Check, Full Pre-Deploy and Windows Basic Check now require the new exam-session.js and exam-timer.js dependencies and run focused refactor regressions.
PL-300 reviewed questions, answer keys, Official QBank, course Question Banks, course Exams, curriculum and protected assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: Exam Navigation & Voucher Context Fix
releases.summary: Keeps the primary navbar visible during Voucher exams and makes PL-300 exam/question context derive from the active Voucher payload instead of stale course setup breadcrumbs.
highlights: Voucher Focus Mode no longer hides the primary sticky topbar during an active Voucher exam.
Voucher exam activity context now identifies Voucher, Data Analysis, and Microsoft PL-300 from the generated Voucher exam payload.
Current-question context and navigator labeling now use the active PL-300 exam label and actual question topic rather than stale English / Module setup text.
Official QBank, My Mistakes, and generic course exam context paths remain unchanged.
PL-300 reviewed questions, answer keys, ranking scopes, timers, Resume, My Mistakes, Official QBank, course banks, exams, and protected assessment payloads remain unchanged.

releases.title: Refactor Foundation: Design Tokens & Ranking Storage
releases.summary: Begins the architecture refactor with behavior-preserving design-token extraction and safe ranking-preference persistence boundaries.
highlights: Light and Dark semantic CSS variables move into a dedicated load-first assets/css/tokens.css file with the v0.20.37 values preserved exactly.
Ranking UI preference reads and writes move behind storage.js safe storage helpers while preserving the existing legacy localStorage key names and saved user selections.
app.js no longer directly accesses localStorage for ranking mode, track, exam, or Voucher ranking preferences.
Quick Local Check and Full Pre-Deploy now require tokens.css so a missing refactor dependency fails before localhost acceptance.
Exam behavior, timer rules, ranking scopes/order, Voucher PL-300 content, answer keys, My Mistakes, Official QBank, course banks, exams, and curriculum remain unchanged.
This is the first incremental refactor slice; Exam Engine extraction is intentionally deferred to a separate test-gated phase rather than bundled into a big-bang rewrite.

releases.title: Voucher Selection Affordance & Visual Clarity Fix
releases.summary: Makes Voucher Custom Practice question-count choices unmistakably clickable and selected in both Light and Dark mode while restoring the Voucher border token consistently.
highlights: Custom Practice 25 / 50 / 100 / Full Reviewed Bank choices now render as explicit selection cards with stronger borders, contrasting surfaces and larger visual affordance.
Hover and keyboard focus states now clearly signal clickability, while the selected choice gains a persistent checkmark so selection is not communicated by color alone.
Dark mode has dedicated default, hover and active card treatments with readable text and visible boundaries.
The Custom Practice section now labels the control group with Choose number of questions and Select one option to continue.
Voucher surfaces now map the legacy --border token to the platform --line token so existing Voucher borders no longer disappear when the variable is unresolved.
Ranked Challenge, Full Bank Ranked Exam, PL-300 reviewed questions, answer keys, ranking/readiness, My Mistakes and protected assessment payloads are unchanged.

releases.title: Full Bank Ranked Exam
releases.summary: Adds a separate ranked PL-300 exam that uses all 180 reviewed questions in one 360-minute Exam Mode attempt without changing the existing 60-question Ranked Challenge leaderboard.
highlights: PL-300 now offers Full Bank Ranked Exam: all 180 reviewed questions in one attempt, 360-minute continuous ranked timer, and feedback only after submission.
Full Bank Ranking is isolated from the existing 60-question Ranked Challenge leaderboard; score ranks first and faster completion time breaks ties within each mode.
The existing 60-question Ranked Challenge remains unchanged with 120 solve minutes, Instant Feedback, solve-time-only timing, Readiness, and Improve My Level.
Full Bank Ranked Exam supports saved-attempt Resume and reconstructs the exact question/option order from compact Voucher resume metadata.
Custom Practice 25 / 50 / 100 / Full Reviewed Bank remains non-ranked and configurable; Track Overall continues to use only Real Exam Size challenge results.
PL-300 reviewed question text, answer keys, option IDs, visuals, Official QBank, course Question Banks, course Exams, My Mistakes, and protected curriculum content are unchanged.

releases.title: Windows Local Start Reliability Hotfix
releases.summary: Makes START-LOCAL.bat reliable on Windows without depending on the installed Node.js state or a single hard-coded localhost port.
highlights: START-LOCAL.bat now always uses the Windows-native PowerShell safety check and loopback local server for ordinary testing, so a present but old or broken Node.js installation cannot intercept startup.
The Windows local server tries port 4173 first and automatically advances to the next available loopback port when the preferred port is already in use.
START-LOCAL.bat now keeps the console open after an unexpected server-start failure so the actual error remains visible for diagnosis.
Developer QA remains unchanged: QUICK-CHECK, FULL-QA, TEST-LOCAL, and RUN-PREFLIGHT continue to use Node.js where appropriate.
Voucher learning flow, PL-300 content, answer keys, ranking/readiness, My Mistakes, Official QBank, course banks, exams, curriculum, and protected assessment payloads are unchanged.

releases.title: Voucher Exam Learning Flow Polish
releases.summary: Polishes Voucher Custom Practice selection and the Instant Feedback exam cycle without changing assessment content or scoring.
highlights: Voucher Custom Practice 25 / 50 / 100 / Full Reviewed Bank choices now retain a visible selected state in Light and Dark mode; the missing Voucher accent token that caused white-on-white selection is fixed at the Voucher surface boundary.
Practice-size buttons now expose aria-pressed state so the selected choice remains explicit to assistive technology as well as visually.
Multi-select Confirm Answer now communicates incomplete, ready-to-confirm, and confirmed states; it remains unavailable until the exact required number of answers is selected.
Single-choice Instant Feedback remains one-click: choosing an option submits immediately with no Confirm Answer step.
Voucher Instant Feedback now keeps Previous / Mark / Next (or Submit) in a sticky action bar while long explanations are being read, and newly opened feedback is brought into view.

PL-300 reviewed question content, answer keys, option IDs, ranking/readiness logic, solve-time timer policy, My Mistakes, Official QBank, course Question Banks, course Exams, and protected curriculum payloads are unchanged.

releases.title: Voucher Answer Cycle Flow Fix
releases.summary: Shortens the PL-300 Ranked Challenge answer cycle and prevents unrelated saved Voucher practice from intercepting the selected path.
highlights: Ranked single-choice questions now submit immediately when an option is selected, lock the answer, show Instant Feedback, and pause the solve timer without a second confirmation click.
Confirm Answer is now shown only for native multi-select questions after the learner selects the required number of answers.
The ranked timer still counts solving time only: single-choice selection moves directly into feedback-paused state, while multi-select stays in solving state until Confirm Answer.

Saved Voucher attempts now intercept launch only when track, Voucher exam, mock kind, and size match the newly selected path; an unrelated Custom Practice no longer opens when starting Ranked Challenge.
Microsoft PL-300 reviewed questions, scoring, option IDs, ranking/readiness rules, My Mistakes, Official QBank, course Question Banks, course Exams, and protected curriculum payloads are unchanged.

releases.title: Voucher Competitive Learning UX
releases.summary: Turns Microsoft PL-300 Voucher into a rank-first competitive learning loop with mandatory Instant Feedback, solve-time-only ranked timing, focused improvement sessions, and exam Focus Mode.
highlights: PL-300 Ranked Challenge now uses one shared contract: 60 questions, 120 solve minutes, mandatory Instant Feedback, explicit answer confirmation, and rank eligibility for every learner.
The ranked timer counts solving time only: it pauses during confirmed feedback, continues while the learner is still solving, and applies away time only to the solving phase.

The Voucher exam page now prioritizes Current Rank, Personal Best, Digilians Readiness, improvement, next-rank target, Ranked Challenge, Improve My Level, and leaderboard preview before Custom Practice.
Improve My Level creates a 25-question non-ranked Instant Feedback session weighted toward weak domains, active Voucher mistakes, and unseen reviewed questions.
Voucher Focus Mode hides the main navbar while solving, adds All / Unanswered / Answered / Marked navigator filters, live selection guidance, and question-card anchored navigation.
Ranked results and attempt history now store/display readiness, solve-only timing and improvement metadata, with Improve My Level as the primary post-challenge action.
Learner-facing PL-300 feedback is structured and removes implementation language such as Option IDs, Safe Shuffle, provenance and runtime metadata while internal provenance remains preserved.
Official QBank, course Question Banks, course Exams, protected data, My Mistakes Wrong-only behavior, and Voucher Track Overall denominator/membership rules remain protected.

releases.title: Voucher UX Restructure
releases.summary: Reorganizes Voucher navigation and Microsoft PL-300 preparation into clearer Practice, Real Exam, Source Mock, Ranking, and progress paths without changing assessment logic.
highlights: Voucher child navigation now resets to the top immediately, eliminating the confusing inherited/smooth scroll position seen when moving from Hub to Track to Exam.
Track exam cards hydrate reviewed-question totals from each exam config instead of displaying a copied stale count; Microsoft PL-300 now shows the current 180 reviewed questions.
Practice sizes are now 25 / 50 / 100 / Full Reviewed Bank, while ranked Real Exam Simulation is a separate 60-question / 120-minute path with its own clear CTA and Exam Ranking action.
Full Source Mocks and empty Attempt History use compact states until useful content exists, and Track Overall Ranking moves into the exam hero instead of a detached footer action row.
The Voucher Hub hero is shorter so track choices appear sooner, while the released exam card becomes a featured certification card with live readiness metadata.
No Voucher bank content, scoring, Safe Shuffle, Resume, Ranking rules, My Mistakes rules, Official QBank, course Question Banks, course Exams, or protected curriculum data changed.

releases.title: Microsoft PL-300 Reviewed Bank Wave 2
releases.summary: Expands the Data Analysis Microsoft PL-300 Voucher from 101 to 180 reviewed production questions while keeping unresolved or stale source variants fail-closed.
highlights: Microsoft PL-300 reviewed production bank expands to 180 canonical questions; 90 remaining canonical drafts stay excluded from Random and Real Exam generation.
The reviewed bank now includes 27 native multi-select questions and 41 questions with safe exhibit assets while preserving stable Option-ID scoring.
Random 25 / 50 / 100, Full Reviewed Bank 180, and Real Exam Size 60 questions / 120 minutes remain available; only Real Exam Size is rank eligible.
Wave 2 uses an explicit reviewed allowlist for standalone Source 2 questions and keeps newly identified stale, ambiguous, legacy, and conflicting variants fail-closed pending owner approval.
Full Source mocks remain withheld until Hotspot, Drag & Drop, case-study, and answer-area-heavy questions can be reconstructed without leaking solutions or changing question meaning.
Official QBank, course Question Banks, course Exams, protected curriculum data, existing Ranking rules, and My Mistakes Wrong-only behavior remain unchanged.

releases.title: Microsoft PL-300 Voucher Production V1
releases.summary: Releases the first Data Analysis Voucher exam with a reviewed PL-300 bank, native multi-select, safe visual-question support, Arabic explanations, and ranked 60-question Real Exam simulation.
highlights: Data Analysis Voucher now contains Microsoft PL-300 Exam with 101 reviewed canonical questions from the two supplied PL-300 PDF sources.
Random 25 / 50 / 100, Full Reviewed Bank, and Real Exam Size 60 questions / 120 minutes are available; only Real Exam Size is rank eligible.
Native multi-select scoring preserves multi-answer questions without converting them to single-choice, and safe option shuffling remains ID-based.
Twenty reviewed questions retain required exhibit/model visuals through cropped answer-safe assets; unsupported visual-heavy Source mocks remain withheld rather than released incompletely.
Approved answer-key conflicts are corrected only in scoring while the original PDF answer text remains preserved in provenance; unreviewed questions stay fail-closed.
Official QBank, course Question Banks, course Exams, protected curriculum data, existing Ranking rules, and My Mistakes Wrong-only behavior remain unchanged.

releases.title: Voucher Ranking Center Integration
releases.summary: Makes Voucher Exam Ranking and Voucher Track Overall first-class modes inside the main Ranking Center while preserving the existing Real Exam Size-only ranking rules.
highlights: Ranking Center now shows dedicated Voucher Track Overall and Voucher Exam Ranking tabs alongside the existing Official and course ranking modes.
Voucher ranking controls are registry-driven: learners choose a Voucher track and, when available, a released rank-eligible Real Exam leaderboard.
Before any Voucher exam is released, both Voucher ranking modes remain visible with clear empty states instead of being hidden.
Voucher Exam Ranking continues to accept only best Real Exam Size attempts; Voucher Track Overall still uses fixed total question volume and Primary Track membership.
No Official QBank content, course Question Banks, Exams, Voucher question content, scoring rules, My Mistakes rules, or learner data schema changed.

releases.title: Voucher Visual Redesign
releases.summary: Refreshes the Voucher Hub with a premium youthful visual system while preserving all Voucher exam, ranking, storage, and My Mistakes behavior.
highlights: Voucher now opens with a stronger premium hero that frames the section as a focused exam-preparation destination.
Data Analysis, Marketing, Graphic Design, UI/UX, and Media Production now use distinct visual accents and richer track-card hierarchy.
Coming Soon cards communicate track identity and preparation status without looking disabled or unfinished.
Responsive hover behavior and reduced-motion fallbacks keep the redesign polished and accessible across desktop and mobile.
No Voucher exam logic, Official QBank content, course Question Banks, Exams, scoring, Ranking rules, My Mistakes rules, or learner data schema changed.

releases.title: Windows PowerShell Parser Fix
releases.summary: Fixes the Windows PowerShell fallback parser error that blocked Node-free START-LOCAL before the basic safety check could run.
highlights: windows-basic-check.ps1 now uses braced variable interpolation before a colon, preventing PowerShell from treating the variable as a drive-qualified reference.
A regression guard scans shipped PowerShell fallback scripts for ambiguous unbraced variable-colon interpolation.
START-LOCAL.bat keeps the same safe behavior: full Node Quick Check when Node is available, Windows PowerShell fallback when it is not.
No Voucher content, Official QBank content, course Question Banks, Exams, scoring, Ranking rules, My Mistakes rules, or learner data schema changed.

releases.title: Windows Local Start Fallback
releases.summary: Makes ordinary Windows localhost testing work even when Node.js is not installed, while preserving the full Node-based developer QA path.
highlights: START-LOCAL.bat now prefers the existing Node Quick Check/server when Node is available and automatically falls back to Windows PowerShell when it is not.
The PowerShell fallback performs a basic required-file, version, and JSON-readability gate before starting a loopback-only local server at 127.0.0.1:4173.
FULL-QA.bat, TEST-LOCAL.bat, and RUN-PREFLIGHT.bat now explain that Node.js 20+ is required instead of failing with a command-not-found message.
The fallback is permanently protected by regression tests and the Node Quick Check; it does not claim to replace JavaScript syntax or full regression testing.
No Voucher content, Official QBank content, course Question Banks, Exams, scoring, Ranking rules, My Mistakes rules, or learner data schema changed.

releases.title: Voucher Infrastructure
releases.summary: Adds the production-ready Voucher subsystem foundation with five tracks, independent learner state, safe mock generation, Voucher My Mistakes integration, and Real Exam Size-only ranking without shipping any Voucher question content yet.
highlights: Voucher is a first-class Home and Navbar destination with Data Analysis, Marketing, Graphic Design, UI/UX, and Media Production tracks; empty tracks remain Coming Soon.
Learners select one Primary Track for Voucher Track Overall competition while remaining free to practice exams from other tracks.

Voucher attempts, seen-question coverage, compact Resume state, Full Source/Random Mock generation, Safe Shuffle, Unseen-First selection, and timed/untimed modes are isolated from existing Course and Official QBank results.
My Mistakes now supports Voucher as a separate source filter with Track and Exam filtering while preserving the Wrong-only / No Answer exclusion rule.
Voucher Exam Ranking and Track Overall foundations accept only Real Exam Size attempts; no production Voucher questions are included in this infrastructure release.
Official QBank, course Question Banks, course Exams, existing assessment registries, scoring, and historical learner progress remain protected and unchanged.

releases.title: Official Final Feedback Mode Choice
releases.summary: Lets learners choose Instant Feedback or Exam Mode before starting the ranked Official Junior or Professional Final simulation.
highlights: Official Junior and Professional Finals now expose both Instant Feedback and Exam Mode in the existing setup screen.
Instant Feedback reveals the correct answer and explanation after each submitted answer while locking that answer; Exam Mode keeps feedback until final submission.
The selected feedback mode is saved with the unfinished attempt and preserved on Resume.
Final question distribution, 120-minute timer, passing score, Ranking behavior, and question selection remain unchanged.
No Official QBank question text, options, correct answers, My Mistakes rules, or learner-state schema changed.

releases.title: Current-Build Platform Health
releases.summary: Makes the Private Error Monitor evaluate the current build by default while preserving historical errors in an explicit All Versions view.
highlights: Platform Health now defaults Error Events, Affected Sessions, Error-Free Sessions and recent errors to the current build only.
A Current Version / All Versions control keeps historical diagnostics accessible without mixing them into current-build health.
Failed to fetch is reclassified as a Network Warning rather than Critical TypeError, including historical events when rendered.
Error-free session rate is calculated from sessions that actually ran the selected version scope.
No learner answers, assessment content, scoring, Ranking, My Mistakes data, or learner-state schema changed.

releases.title: My Mistakes Answered-Only Guard
releases.summary: Keeps unanswered questions out of My Mistakes and removes only legacy Official QBank entries that were imported without a real learner answer.
highlights: No Answer / Unanswered questions are no longer classified as mistakes when Official QBank exams are submitted.
Legacy Official QBank migration no longer fabricates a wrong option when no saved answer exists.
Previously imported unanswered-only Official items are pruned when My Mistakes opens, while genuine Study and Exam wrong answers are preserved.
Correct answers continue to support My Mistakes recovery streaks; only mistake creation requires a real wrong answer.
No question bank, correct answer, scoring, timer, Ranking, exam order, or learner result schema changed.

releases.title: Track-Grouped Exam Navigator
releases.summary: Simplifies the exam navigator by grouping every question under its Data Analysis track instead of repeating topic/section groups.
highlights: Navigator now creates one group per track such as Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
All question numbers for the same track are collected under that track even when their topics differ or appear later in the exam.
Stable original question indexes preserve Current, Answered, Correct/Wrong, and Marked states after visual regrouping.
Current-question source and topic context remain visible above the question while the navigator stays compact.
No question order, question text, answers, scoring, timer, Ranking, My Mistakes data, or assessment-bank content changed.

releases.title: Workspace Cleanup
releases.summary: Removes redundant documentation mirrors and stale development artifacts while adding a permanent workspace-cleanliness regression gate.
highlights: Removed 90 redundant HTML documentation mirrors where the Markdown source is retained.
Removed stale Excel intake/final-clean root markers and temporary superpowers planning/spec artifacts.
Replaced the oversized release-history README with a concise current-state operating guide.
Added a workspace-cleanliness regression test to prevent redundant documentation and stale artifacts from returning.
No Official QBank, course Question Bank, Exam payload, scoring rule, learner state, Ranking behavior, or protected curriculum data changed.

releases.title: Local QA Toolkit
releases.summary: Restores self-contained local pre-deploy tooling and adds a fast safety check that must pass before localhost starts, with no learner-facing assessment or data changes.
highlights: START-LOCAL.bat runs Quick Check first and refuses to start localhost when a gate fails.
FULL-QA.bat runs the complete pre-deploy suite without starting a server.
TEST-LOCAL.bat runs full QA first and starts localhost only after every automated gate passes.
Restored local pre-deploy, Excel intake, path portability and local server tooling inside the ZIP.
No question, answer, scoring, Ranking, My Mistakes, learner storage or assessment-bank content changed.

releases.title: Legacy Word Bullet Rendering Fix
releases.summary: Normalizes legacy Word/Wingdings bullet glyphs at display time so imported multi-line questions render cleanly without changing source question data or technical code formatting.
highlights: Legacy U+F0B7 Word/Wingdings bullets now display as standard bullets in questions.
Five affected Looker Studio Official QBank questions render readable KPI/list lines.
The repair is presentation-only; Official QBank source JSON remains unchanged.
SQL, Python, DAX, Excel and Power Query M code newlines and technical rendering remain protected.
Exam logic, answers, Ranking, My Mistakes and learner state are unchanged.

releases.title: Section-Aware Exam Navigator
releases.summary: Groups exam question numbers under clear Track and Section/Topic headings while preserving the exact question order and existing exam behavior.
highlights: Navigator numbers are grouped by contiguous Track + Section/Topic metadata without reordering questions.
The group containing the current question is highlighted for faster orientation.
Section headings show question counts and can be collapsed or expanded.
Responsive layouts keep 5-column desktop, 8-column tablet and 6-column mobile question grids inside each section.
No QBank, Practice/Exam bank, Ranking, timer, results, answers or learner-storage behavior changed.

releases.title: Exam Activity & Question Context
releases.summary: Adds clear activity-level and current-question provenance inside Official QBank and My Mistakes exam flows.
highlights: Exam activity bar identifies Official QBank/My Mistakes scope, level, track and activity.
Each current question identifies its source family, track and topic.
Navigator heading reflects the current activity instead of the generic Questions label.
My Mistakes mixed-track practice shows exact provenance for the question being solved.
No question text, answer keys, Ranking rules, result calculations or learner data changed.

releases.title: Excel Full Track Exam Flow Fix
releases.summary: Replaces the misleading locked Excel Week Exam card with the ready ranked Full Track Exam while preserving Week Practice and intentionally locked Week Exams.
highlights: Excel Study → Practice → Exam flow now exposes the ready 50-question / 60-minute ranked Full Track Exam directly from every Excel week.
The selected-week hint now explains that Study and Practice are week-scoped while the Full Track Exam covers all 3 Excel weeks.
Saved Full Track attempts show In progress and Resume Full Track Exam.
The duplicate standalone Excel track-exam row is removed so the learning flow has one clear exam call to action.
No Excel Study, Practice, Exam bank, Ranking rule, result logic, or learner data changed.

releases.title: Excel Metadata Consistency Cleanup
releases.summary: Normalizes Excel production metadata to the approved Study, Practice and Full Track Exam state while preserving intentionally locked Week Exams and separate Data Analysis Final readiness.
highlights: Excel productionStats now reports FINAL READY with 29 sources / 610 slides / 24 Groups / 96 lessons / 294 topics.
Practice and independent Track Exam metadata now report 228 + 228 questions with a validated 50-question ranked form.
All three Excel curriculum weeks are confirmed audited and produced; Week Exams remain intentionally locked.
Excel curriculum completion is now explicit while Data Analysis Final bank readiness remains a separate gate.
No Study lesson, Practice question, Exam question, Ranking rule, or learner-state behavior changed.

releases.title: UX Consistency & Navigation Polish
releases.summary: Polishes exam navigation and accessibility without changing approved learning, assessment, ranking, or learner-data behavior.
highlights: Full Track Exams return learners to the same learning track from Setup, Exit, Results and Review flows.
Keyboard focus indicators are now consistent across interactive controls.
Mark for Review keeps readable warning contrast in Dark Mode.
Exam answered progress and instant feedback expose polite live-region updates for assistive technology.
No Study, Practice, Exam bank, Ranking rule, or learner-state data changed.

releases.title: Startup UX & Performance Guardrails
releases.summary: Prevents interaction before core platform data is ready, applies the saved theme before first paint, and adds a permanent startup performance budget without changing approved learning or assessment content.
highlights: Entry actions stay disabled until core platform data finishes loading, preventing slow-network startup races.
Saved Light/Dark theme is applied before the main stylesheet to reduce first-paint theme flash.
Pre-Deploy now enforces startup dependency count, raw payload and gzip-estimate performance budgets.
Startup recovery remains independent and bounded for load failures or initialization timeouts.
Study, Practice, Excel Full Track Exam, Official QBank, Ranking and learner data behavior remain unchanged.

releases.title: Platform Stabilization & Data Safety
releases.summary: Hardens learner progress storage, migration and restore safety while improving Platform Health diagnostics without changing approved learning or assessment content.
highlights: Adds an explicit learner storage schema with non-destructive migration and future-version protection.
Browser storage failures no longer crash startup; learners receive a local-save warning instead.
Backup/Restore now preserves the learner storage schema and rolls back all learner keys if a restore write fails mid-operation.
Platform Health classifies Critical / Error / Warning events and exposes current-version error counts plus the last error timestamp.
Excel Study, Practice, Full Track Exam, Official QBank, Ranking rules and approved assessment content remain unchanged.

releases.title: Excel Full Track Exam Production
releases.summary: Opens the ranked Excel Full Track Exam with an independent source-grounded bank, validated dynamic 50-question forms, and Week/Group result analytics.
highlights: Independent 228-question Excel Track Exam bank covers the approved assessment-eligible concepts without copying Practice V1 items.
Dynamic 50-question forms enforce Week quotas 12/20/18 and difficulty quotas 13 Easy / 25 Medium / 12 Hard.
All 23 assessment-capable Excel Learning Groups are represented; Group 14 stays excluded because it is bridge-only.
Track Exam is 60 minutes, 60% passing, ranked, resumable, MARK-enabled, and integrated with My Mistakes.
Results add Week and Group breakdowns while Week Practice remains non-ranked and Week Exams remain locked.

releases.title: Runtime Compatibility Hotfix
releases.summary: Improves browser compatibility for UUID generation and keeps benign ResizeObserver browser noise out of Platform Health.
highlights: Centralizes UUID generation with crypto.randomUUID when available, crypto.getRandomValues fallback, and a final standards-shaped local fallback.
New learner player IDs and exam client-attempt IDs no longer fail in environments without crypto.randomUUID.
Anonymous analytics visitor/session IDs use the same compatibility UUID helper.
Known benign ResizeObserver loop notifications are filtered before Private Error Monitor rate-limit/error-health counting.
Excel Study and Practice remain unchanged; Excel Exam remains locked.

releases.title: Excel Practice Production V1
releases.summary: Opens source-scoped Excel Practice across all three Excel weeks while keeping Excel Exam and Ranking locked.
highlights: 228 Practice questions cover every assessment-eligible Excel concept exactly once: Week 1 = 53, Week 2 = 89, Week 3 = 86.
Every question is course-source-only with English MCQ text and Arabic deep explanation for A/B/C/D.
Practice is untimed, instant-feedback, resumable and integrated with My Mistakes.
Practice registry items are non-ranked and never sync attempts to the shared leaderboard.
Excel Exam remains locked for the next production phase.

releases.title: Excel Week 3 Study Production
releases.summary: Completes Excel Study coverage with the final Week 3 source batch while keeping assessment production gated.
highlights: 10 final Excel source files / 154 slides audited and mapped.
8 approved Week 3 Groups / 34 Deep Learning V3.2 lessons / 123 production concepts.
Full Excel Study now spans 24 Groups / 96 lessons / 294 topics.
Practice and Exam remain locked pending final Study/source-trace/local visual QA.
Final Clean package restores Week 2 audit/release QA artifacts and the full local Pre-Deploy workflow.

releases.title: Startup Cache Compatibility Hotfix
releases.summary: Prevents browsers from mixing a new app module with a stale cached storage module during startup.
highlights: Versioned the startup-critical storage.js import so V0.20.5 always loads the matching storage API.
Prevents the V0.20.4 startup failure when a cached V0.20.3 storage module lacks clearOfficialMistakeFlags.
Reset My Mistakes behavior and all learner results, Ranking, Study progress and assessment content remain unchanged.

releases.title: Reset My Mistakes
releases.summary: My Mistakes can now be reset safely after testing without deleting learner results or Ranking history.
highlights: Added a Reset My Mistakes button with the current mistake count and two-step confirmation.
Clears Needs Review, Improving and Mastered history for the current local learner profile.
Clears only Official QBank mistake flags to prevent previously imported test mistakes from returning after refresh.
Preserves Exam results, Ranking, QBank reviewed questions, bookmarks, saved answers, Study progress, name and avatar.
Any unfinished My Mistakes recovery attempt is cleared so the reset starts from a clean recovery state.

releases.title: Learn Coverage Optional-Metadata Hotfix
releases.summary: Learn coverage no longer crashes when a syllabus topic intentionally omits optional importance metadata.
highlights: Fixed the Learn TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toUpperCase).
Excel syllabus topics without importance now render the neutral MAPPED status instead of throwing.
The fix is renderer-only; Excel educational content, source traces, Practice/Exam gates and all assessment banks remain unchanged.

releases.title: Excel Week 2 Study Production
releases.summary: Excel Week 2 is now implemented as 8 connected Deep Learning V3.2 groups with 35 source-traced lessons.
highlights: Added Excel Week 2 Study: 8 approved Learning Groups / 35 lessons / 101 non-reuse production concepts.
Preserved all Week 1 overlap rules; reuse-only concepts are referenced instead of duplicated.
Added source-supported Technical Labs for VBA, Python in Excel and Power Query M.
Explicit QA labels cover Text.End presentation correction, ActiveX/VBA environment dependency, visual-only source limits and missing companion files.
Updated Excel curriculum/syllabus mapping to 171 unique Week 1+2 production topics across 19 source files and 456 slides.
Practice and Exam remain locked until Week 2 Study/source-trace and local visual QA approval.

releases.title: Navbar Readability Polish
releases.summary: Desktop navigation is wider so long destinations such as Official QBank stay on one line.
highlights: Widened the desktop navigation without shrinking label text.
Official QBank and My Mistakes now use no-wrap labels.
Navigation items use natural flexible widths instead of forcing every item into the same width.
Responsive tablet/mobile navigation behavior is preserved.
No educational, assessment, ranking, analytics or My Mistakes data changed.

releases.title: My Mistakes V1
releases.summary: Wrong answers now feed one local recovery notebook across Official QBank, Practice and Exams.
highlights: Unified My Mistakes page with source, track, topic and mastery filters.
Needs Review → Improving → Mastered uses a two-correct recovery streak after the latest wrong answer.
Existing Official QBank mistakes are imported automatically without changing official source data.
New course Practice/Exam attempts save exact wrong-question snapshots and also count later correct recoveries.
Practice My Mistakes and single-question Retry are local-only and never enter Ranking.
My Mistakes is included in learner Backup/Restore while Analytics/Admin data stays excluded.

releases.title: Shared Ranking Avatars
releases.summary: Everyone can now see each learner's selected Soft 3D avatar across shared leaderboards after a one-time profile sync.
highlights: New Supabase ranking_profiles table stores player_id + avatar_id only.
All Ranking rows and Top-3 podium positions can render other learners' avatars.
Changing an avatar updates the shared profile instead of waiting for a new exam attempt.
Historical leaderboard attempts gain avatars automatically once that learner opens V0.19.6.
Gender/category is never uploaded; ranking attempts and scoring schemas remain unchanged.

releases.title: Ranking Avatar Integration
releases.summary: Your selected Soft 3D avatar now appears on your own leaderboard row and podium position instead of falling back to initials.
highlights: Local learner avatar renders on the current user's exam leaderboard row.
Local learner avatar renders on aggregate/Official Total Grades ranking rows.
If the learner reaches Top 3, the same avatar appears on the podium.
Other users remain initials because avatar/category data is still not uploaded to Supabase.
No ranking score, identity, privacy or assessment schema changes.

releases.title: Returning User Avatar Rollout
releases.summary: Existing learners without a current Soft 3D avatar now receive a one-time required avatar picker automatically when they return.
highlights: Returning users with a saved name and no current avatar see the picker automatically on platform load.
The one-time rollout cannot be dismissed with Escape, backdrop click, close or initials fallback.
Saving an avatar continues directly to Home and the rollout does not appear again.
Existing valid V0.19.3 avatars are preserved and never prompted again.
New learner onboarding keeps its existing optional initials fallback.

releases.title: Soft 3D Avatar Pack
releases.summary: The avatar system now uses the requested polished Soft 3D cartoon characters as real local image assets.
highlights: 16 Soft 3D avatars: 4 Boys, 4 Girls and 8 Animals.
Local WebP avatar assets replace the previous approximate SVG characters.
All/Boys/Girls/Animals filters and Surprise Me remain available.
Navbar and Profile render the selected Soft 3D character.
Avatar choice remains local-only and is included only in learner-controlled Backup/Restore.

releases.title: Funny Avatar Profiles V1
releases.summary: Learners can now choose a playful Modern 3D / Soft avatar by Male, Female or Neutral category and keep it locally with their profile.
highlights: 14 built-in Modern 3D / Soft avatars: 5 Male, 5 Female and 4 Neutral.
First-time avatar picker after saving a learner name, plus Change Avatar from Profile.
Surprise Me randomizer and initials fallback.
Avatar appears in Navbar and Profile while preserving initials if no avatar is selected.
Gender/category and avatar choice stay local, are excluded from Analytics, and are included only in the learner-controlled backup file.

releases.title: Profile Access & Layering Fix
releases.summary: The Profile drawer now behaves as a true modal layer over navigation, and administrative tools are visible only after verified Admin access.
highlights: Profile backdrop now covers the sticky navbar and update notice correctly.
Opening Profile locks page scrolling and makes the underlying app inert.
Escape, backdrop click and close button all dismiss the Profile drawer.
Backup, What's New, Analytics and Validator close Profile before opening the next layer.
Exam / Bank JSON Validator moved into an Admin Tools group and requires verified Supabase Admin access.
